premises.text: Retail category managers cannot manually keep thousands of SKUs competitive and profitable against many online rivals
premises.evidence_span: he's got to do that for 25,000 products every single hour. And that is a non-trivial problem

premises.text: A SaaS price-optimization platform monitors competitive positioning and sets dynamic prices to grow revenue without losing margin dollars
premises.evidence_span: We are a price optimization company

premises.text: Strategy simulation uses historical data to project revenue and profit before retailers submit pricing strategies
premises.evidence_span: Boomerang has looked up the past historical data and has given me some projections in terms of revenue and profits

premises.text: Monetization is monthly SaaS subscription fees from large e-commerce retailers
premises.evidence_span: We are a SaaS product, which means we monetize with monthly subscription fees

value.text: E-commerce retailers price for competitiveness and profitability at scale
value.evidence_span: dynamically price your items for competitiveness and profitability

causal_links.evidence_span: You cannot achieve these results consistently with just price matching

notes: Competitive dashboard, strategy builder, and what-if simulation folded as one optimization product surface with simulation as enabling cascade detail (v1.5.1 §4.1.7). Canon Rebel case and sales/margin lifts excluded as traction evidence of the mechanism. Bookings figures excluded per §4.2. Anti-template: problem, product, and SaaS monetization separately revisable.
